text: The world here feels meticulously constructed for the pursuit of knowledge and innovation. The meeting room behind glass exudes a sterile anticipation, as though prepared for minds to converge and create. The R+D exhibit, with its bold design and interactive elements, pulsates with the energy of progress. I feel a blend of curiosity and humility; curiosity at the potential for discovery, humility in the face of human ingenuity. The space invites reflection: what new questions will arise here, and what boundaries will be pushed?
